headline: Apple Reclaims the Crown as a China Chip Scare Sinks the Semis
summary: Wall Street opened strong on a sharp oil selloff but faded as a report on Chinese progress in advanced lithography rattled ASML and the entire semi complex. Apple leapfrogged Nvidia to reclaim its title as the world's most valuable listed company, right as the Fed, big-tech earnings and Q2 GDP move into focus.
